lang_en:
We both got leave for December.
She wanted Kasol. I wanted Manali.
We argued for days.
So we settled it on NakshIQ.
Manali, December. Eight out of ten.
And its busiest month.
Kasol, December. Skip.
She read it again, slowly.
Then she started packing for Manali.
In Manali, she stole my scarf.
Our only fight all week.
Travel intelligence settles the big stuff before you leave.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
हम दोनों को दिसंबर की छुट्टी मिल गई।
उसे कसोल जाना था। मुझे मनाली।
कई दिन बहस चली।
तो हमने NakshIQ पर फ़ैसला किया।
मनाली, दिसंबर। दस में से आठ।
और सबसे भीड़ वाला महीना भी।
कसोल, दिसंबर। स्किप।
उसने दोबारा पढ़ा, आराम से।
फिर मनाली के लिए पैकिंग शुरू कर दी।
मनाली में, उसने मेरा मफ़लर चुरा लिया।
पूरे हफ़्ते बस यही एक झगड़ा हुआ।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस मतलब, बड़े फ़ैसले निकलने से पहले ही तय।
NakshIQ.
shots: s1: Apartment, evening: the man and woman (late 20s) at a dining table, each pointing at their own laptop, arguing playfully, screens not visible.
s2: Close-up: the man holds his phone between them and both lean in, screen glow on their faces, the screen never visible.
s3: The woman takes the phone, reads it again slowly, shrugs, and starts folding sweaters into a backpack.
s4: Manali, evening: the two walk down a hillside lane in winter jackets, warm lights in the windows, no one else in frame.
s5: Close-up: she tugs the scarf from his neck and wraps it around her own, grinning, while he pretends to protest.
s6: A guesthouse balcony in Manali, same evening: the two sit close, her head on his shoulder, both relaxed.
